versions.subject: feat: new rule related to `roboform` dll sideloading (#4230)
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith:
        - '\roboform.dll'
        - '\roboform-x64.dll'
filter_main_path:
    Image|startswith:
        - ' C:\Program Files (x86)\Siber Systems\AI RoboForm\'
        - ' C:\Program Files\Siber Systems\AI RoboForm\'
    Image|endswith:
        - '\robotaskbaricon.exe'
        - '\robotaskbaricon-x64.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: ImageLoaded IN ("*\\roboform.dll", "*\\roboform-x64.dll") NOT (Image IN (" C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Siber Systems\\AI RoboForm\\*", " C:\\Program Files\\Siber Systems\\AI RoboForm\\*") Image IN ("*\\robotaskbaricon.exe", "*\\robotaskbaricon-x64.exe"))
